name: Fateshifters
description: Tokens of Aminatou's power that rewind a fatal choice.

description_citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
description_citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Aminatou hands out the fateshifter tokens, giving the Wanderer a second.
timeline.quote: She handed them around the members of the team, giving the Wanderer a second.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: In a fateshifter vision, the Wanderer charges, cuts open Nashi's cage and is killed by branches bursting from her ribs.
timeline.quote: Blood began to blossom on the front of her tabard before tree branches burst out of her ribcage

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The vision shatters as the Wanderer clutches Aminatou's fateshifter, having narrowly averted the choice.
timeline.quote: the vision shattered as the Wanderer gasped, hand going to the pocket where she had tucked Aminatou's fateshifter

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: In a fateshifter vision, the creature's claw rips Tyvar open through the phantom's chest.
timeline.quote: slicing through skin and muscle with ease

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The vision breaks and Tyvar, clutching his fateshifter, realizes he must stand and fight.
timeline.quote: the moment shattered like the ice at a river's edge on a winter morning, leaving Tyvar gasping, one hand going to the fateshifter he had tucked into his belt

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Zimone's fateshifter pulls her back and she begs Tyvar to release the camouflage.
timeline.quote: her fateshifter a burning coal against her skin

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer frees Nashi and gives him a small object, saying he can change his fate.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A cultist stabs Niko through the eye in a fateshifter vision.
timeline.quote: Niko felt the blade pierce their eye and continue through the thin barrier of their skull

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The fateshifter rewinds the moment and Niko dodges and captures the cultist.
timeline.quote: The world snapped like a tightened bowstring, and Niko was looking up at Valgavoth.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2024.

pages_say.description: Carved figures holding a burst of Aminatou's power that rewind a fatal choice once per person.
